title: commit-city payload, schema 1
description: Everything the viewer draws. Times are integer minutes since `epoch` (local midnight). A file's size is its line count; 0 means the file does not exist at that moment.

kind.description: Whose commits the city shows. Absent means a person (the CLI and Action). Orgs and repos show everyone's commits.

avatar.description: source URL; the page embeds the image itself

offset.description: minutes east of UTC; the clock and day boundaries use it

t_end.description: last minute of the lapse (build time)

langs.description: language classes in palette order; files reference them by index

who.description: who wrote the commits, for the agent lens: 'human' first, then 'bot' (automation) if any commit is one, then the ids of AI agents (schema/agents.json) by descending commit count, ties by id. Commit rows reference it by index. Written by every builder since the agent lens; absent in older payloads, where every commit counts as human

contributions.description: GitHub calendar total over the window (includes PRs, issues, reviews, private)

repos.description: one island per repo, most of your commits first

fp.description: first-parent commits replayed on the default branch

p.description: file paths; an aggregate ends in '/…'

e.description: per file: flat [t0, size0, t1, size1, ...], t ascending

m.description: your commits: [t (author time), files touched, [file indexes]], plus w for a commit not written by a human

prefixItems.description: w: index into the top-level `who` (never 0); absent means human
